incidents.phase: pytest plugin discovery before test collection
incidents.error_summary: Unrelated installed nengo plugin declares obsolete startdir argument for pytest_report_collectionfinish.
incidents.remedy: Set PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD=1 in the isolated worker. No installed package is removed or changed.
incidents.retry_rule: Preserve original logs/status and use a new attempt directory; rerun compatibility gate before training.
